category: Attention block with rotary position embedding (transformer layer)
edge_cases: extends i8_attention_block with a per-position RoPE pre-rotation of Q and K over feature pairs (d, d+HALF) before QK^T
RoPE rotation runs on HVX/scalar as a shared prefix; the baseline pays the SAME rotation cost, so the win comes from the HMX matmuls
Qr is the uint8 HMX activation (clamped to [0,255]); Kr is the int8 weight (clamped to [-128,127]); rot_shift=4 carries the table's 1/16 fixed-point scale
position 0 -> identity rotation (cos=8=1.0, sin=0); position 1 pair 0 -> 90-degree rotation (cos=0, sin=8) swapping the pair
query row 1 forced all-zero -> uniform softmax edge after rotation
cos/sin tables in [-8,8] and rot_shift=4 keep Qr in [0,7], Kr in [-3,3] so QK^T |acc| <= 1344 -> requant field 1428 < 2048 (exact)
softmax over the KEY axis; A.V accumulator stays < 2048 (probs is a normalized row summing to ~255)
both HMX matmuls: 2x2 grid of 32x32 crouton tiles, 2-tile reduction, one mxclracc per output tile
crouton pack/unpack staged in cacheable DDR + bulk 128B HVX vector copies to/from VTCM (scalar VTCM access ~48 cyc)
nearmiss_skip_rope omits the rotation (raw Q,K into QK^T) -> INCORRECT (3906/4096 wrong)
nearmiss_wrongpair rotates adjacent pairs (2d,2d+1) instead of (d,d+HALF) -> INCORRECT (236/4096 wrong)
poisoned output buffer; runtime cos/sin/exp tables (anti-hardcode)
name: i8_rope_attention_block

params.cos_lut: int8[S x HALF] runtime per-position rotation cosines (Q3 amplitude ~8 = 1.0)
params.exp_lut: 256 uint8 entries (runtime), fixed-point exp, index 255 = exp(0)
params.scale: arithmetic >>4 on the 0x40-requant field (net ~1/15, in the 1/sqrt(D) regime)
params.sin_lut: int8[S x HALF] runtime per-position rotation sines

signal: RoPE attention block (rotary embedding + matmul + softmax)
